pool.text: Italian naturalist Luigi d'Albertis visited Sorong and reported the population was Muslim.
A colonial post was established on Doom Island, serving as the Dutch center.
Sorong was occupied by the Empire of Japan during World War II.
Oil production dropped another thirty-three percent after declining following the war.
Oil production more than trebled from earlier levels under Indonesian administration.
Sorong was reformed into an autonomous city by the government.
Sorong was reformed into an administrative city following its autonomous status.
Administrative cities were abolished, granting Sorong full city status and separating it.
The city comprised six districts at the census conducted in this year.
Musician Airileke released a single titled Sorong Samarai after receiving nominations.
The official estimate of population reached two hundred eighty-six thousand residents.
